message.content:
Here’s a list of the public holidays in Canada for 2023 that create long weekends (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, or that are observed on the nearest weekday if they fall on a weekend). These are the dates you’ll see in most Canadian provinces and territories:

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Impact |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sunday | Observed Mon 2 – 3‑day weekend |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Heritage Day (New Brunswick) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Mar 17 (Friday) | Friday | 3‑day weekend |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Friday | 3‑day weekend |
| Easter Monday (Quebec, New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador) | Apr 10 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| National Indigenous Peoples Day (Yukon, Northwest Territory) | Jun 21 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Saturday | Observed Mon 3 – 3‑day weekend |
| Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Aug 7 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Saturday | Observed Mon 13 – 3‑day weekend |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tuesday | 3‑day weekend (if you count the 3‑day stretch from Dec 24–26) |

**Notes**

* **Observances** – If a holiday falls on a weekend, most provinces observe it on the following Monday (or preceding Friday). The table above shows the *official* date and the *observed* date where applicable.
* **Province‑specific holidays** – Some holidays are only observed in certain provinces/territories (e.g., Family Day, Louis Riel Day, Heritage Day, etc.). The table lists the ones that create long weekends in the provinces that observe them.
* **Other holidays** – There are additional holidays that don’t create long weekends (e.g., Canada Day on July 1 is a Saturday, so it doesn’t add an extra day unless you count the weekend itself).

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the full list of all public holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends) or province‑specific details, let me know!
